about: Every game image: one PNG per key at assets/sprites/final/<category>/<key>.png (key = file name, unique). Edit by hand; art.py suggest-roofs fills houseRoofs and art.py process fills the atlas tables. See scripts/art/README.md.

budget.rule: always art.py generate --dry-run first; the ledger total may never pass this

have.south: v3 walking, 8 frames, from the trial (animation group 6b9fe7e3)

pick.steps: the two frames with the feet furthest apart, half a cycle apart, measured on the bottom sixth of the figure: side views (east, west) the widest spread; front and back views (south, north) the left foot lowest, then the right foot lowest

standIn.note: the current sheet (one still pose per direction) stays until the walk is generated

standIn.note: procedural: the sand/asphalt shapes with concrete (greyed sand with slab joints) composited in

tile.wang: local tile id = set base + NW*8 + NE*4 + SW*2 + SE*1, where a corner is 1 when it is the set's upper terrain; corners below are [NW, NE, SW, SE]

assets.note: Ground atlas for the Masroor Tiled map: 8 x 6 tiles of 16 px, margin 1, spacing 2, edges extruded. Asphalt recoloured to the original map's blue-grey (legacy look).

tile.encoding: patterns[i] is local tile id i: 16 characters, 4 rows of 4 cells (4 x 4 px each), "." none, "W" white paint, "Y" yellow paint. Only tiles with asphalt at all four ground corners carry paint (masroor_ground.paint_grid).

assets.note: Runway and taxiway paint read from the original map (4 px cells, like the legacy map). One tile per distinct pattern the map uses, sorted; build-map rebuilds it with the map (8 columns, 1 px extruded).
